newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan hangs two women for murder.
newsitem.headline: Jordan hangs two women for murder.

text.p: Jordan has hanged two women who shot dead an alleged wife-beater and hid his dismembered body in a cesspit, the Jordan Times said on Thursday.
The newspaper said Amira Salem and Aida Hussein were executed for killing Salem's husband Murad Yousef in April last year.
Court documents said Salem plotted to kill Yousef because he physically abused her, threatened to leave her, and brought other women into their house, the paper said.
Salem and Hussein, luring Yousef into a bedroom by telling him he could take Hussein as a mistress, told him to lie face down on a bed while Hussein pretended to undress for him.

Hussein then shot him and they cut his body up into eight pieces, cooked his head to try to make it unrecognisable, put all the pieces into plastic bags and threw them into a cesspit, press reports at the time of sentencing said.
The two women were sentenced to death in November after Hussein told her relatives about the plot.
The Jordan Times said they were the seventh and eighth people to be executed in Jordan this year.
